title: This is my first game, CYBER-PROTO
author: Excellent_Tea5408
selftext:
This is my first game, CYBER-PROTO



Hello everyone! This is my first game, CYBER-PROTO!

It's a casual idle game focused on opening card packs, collecting cards, and building your collection.

Steam is still reviewing my submission, so I'll need to wait patiently for the approval process to be completed. Once everything is approved, I'll share the Steam Wishlist link with everyone!

In the meantime, here's my Discord community. If you're interested, I'd be happy to have you join!

[https://discord.gg/xMxf5GCjK](https://discord.gg/xMxf5GCjK)

The game features 200 collectible cards across different rarity tiers, with up to 600 entries to discover and collect in the in-game collection book.

There are also 300 achievements waiting to be unlocked!

Thank you for your support! I hope you enjoy the game when it launches. Any feedback, suggestions, or ideas are always welcome!

Happy gaming! 🚀

I used AI tools like Claude and Gemini to help me develop this game.I'm a visual artist with no programming background.

I used **Claude** to help with code architecture and game logic, and **Gemini** to troubleshoot development issues.

I handled the game design, UI, artwork, and overall creative direction.

With the help of AI, I was able to create my first idle card-collecting game, featuring **200 collectible cards and 300 unlockable achievements**!

Claude helped me develop several core game systems, including:

* Card pack opening and card drawing systems
* Card rarity and drop rate calculations
* Idle income and resource generation
* Achievement unlocking system
* Game save and load system
